title: Apply newly uploaded images as canonical public assets

requirements.summary: Replace the app’s canonical public image assets (bg.png, vinyl.png, bodyhdd.png, disk.png, arm.png) with the newly uploaded visuals (bg-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png, arm-3.png).
acceptanceCriteria: The files frontend/public/bg.png, frontend/public/vinyl.png, frontend/public/bodyhdd.png, frontend/public/disk.png, and frontend/public/arm.png exist in the repository and are the newly uploaded images (bg-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png, arm-3.png respectively).
On a fresh load, the background, vinyl image, and HDD hub layers render the real uploaded visuals (not the SVG placeholders), assuming the canonical files exist.

file_operations.description: Replace the current canonical background asset with the newly uploaded image content from bg-3.png (canonical filename must remain bg.png for BASE_URL-safe resolution).
Replace the current canonical vinyl asset with the newly uploaded image content from vinyl-3.png (canonical filename must remain vinyl.png for BASE_URL-safe resolution).
Replace the current canonical HDD body asset with the newly uploaded image content from bodyhdd-3.png (canonical filename must remain bodyhdd.png for BASE_URL-safe resolution).
Replace the current canonical HDD disk asset with the newly uploaded image content from disk-3.png (canonical filename must remain disk.png for BASE_URL-safe resolution).
Replace the current canonical HDD arm asset with the newly uploaded image content from arm-3.png (canonical filename must remain arm.png for BASE_URL-safe resolution).

requirements.summary: Preserve the originally uploaded filenames in the repository alongside the canonical assets, without changing runtime references.
acceptanceCriteria: The repository contains copies of the original uploaded assets using their original filenames (bg-3.png, vinyl-3.png, bodyhdd-3.png, disk-3.png, arm-3.png) in a non-conflicting public-accessible location (e.g., under frontend/public/assets/uploads/ or similar).
The live app continues to reference only the canonical filenames (bg.png, vinyl.png, bodyhdd.png, disk.png, arm.png) via the existing asset URL resolver; no code changes are required for references.

file_operations.description: Add a preserved copy of the originally uploaded bg-3.png into a non-conflicting public-accessible location for reference (do not change app code to point to it).
Add a preserved copy of the originally uploaded vinyl-3.png into a non-conflicting public-accessible location for reference (do not change app code to point to it).
Add a preserved copy of the originally uploaded bodyhdd-3.png into a non-conflicting public-accessible location for reference (do not change app code to point to it).
Add a preserved copy of the originally uploaded disk-3.png into a non-conflicting public-accessible location for reference (do not change app code to point to it).
Add a preserved copy of the originally uploaded arm-3.png into a non-conflicting public-accessible location for reference (do not change app code to point to it).
